=== USER'S QUESTION ===
A 4B instruct model (Qwen3.5-4B, 32 blocks) answers animal questions. A "suppressed
activation" analysis selects, per token position, a rank-8 readout-direction subspace whose
logits rise then fall across chosen layers. The user asks: identify what the LAST THREE
blocks (29,30,31) suppress; then decide where an intervention should act — early (their
suggestion: layer 3), where the components are built, after built/before suppressed, or at
multiple layers. They note raw activation norms across layers are not comparable semantic
strengths. A same-procedure location comparison is running.

=== PRIMARY EVIDENCE 1: the applied edit (verbatim, scripts/demo.py) ===
elif operation == "common_replace":
    # h'_p = h_p + C (P_d d_p − P_s h_p), per active position p.
    spec = common_specs[residual_layer]
    if hidden.shape[1] > 1:
        src, dproj = spec["src"], spec["donor_proj"]
    else:
        src, dproj = spec["decode_src"], spec["decode_proj"]
    coords = torch.einsum("khr,bkh->bkr", src, h)
    span = torch.einsum("bkr,khr->bkh", coords, src)
    patched = h + strength * (dproj.unsqueeze(0) - span)

=== PRIMARY EVIDENCE 2: basis/projector construction (verbatim, scripts/oat_sweep.py) ===
src_bases, src_sel = suppressed_activation_subspace(
    source["residuals"].permute(1, 0, 2), unembedding, norm_gain,
    early_layer=cfg.detector_layers[0], peak_layer=cfg.detector_layers[1],
    output_layer=cfg.detector_layers[2], rank=cfg.rank, normalize_unembedding_rows=True)
# (same for target/donor); per-position rank-8 orthonormal bases
def union_basis(win):
    m = win.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(win.shape[1], -1)  # (hidden, r*W)
    u, s_vals, _ = torch.linalg.svd(m, full_matrices=False)
    tol = max(m.shape) * torch.finfo(s_vals.dtype).eps * s_vals[0]
    support = int((s_vals > tol).sum())
    u = u[:, :support]
    ...
    return u, s_vals, support
# top8_union arm: U_s, U_d = U_s[:, :8], U_d[:, :8] (declared applied projector)
# donor states: d_o = donor residual at the SAME intervention layer, end-aligned
#   offset o (1..3); decode uses frozen final-prefill donor state and the SAME
#   common projector (per_token arm alone uses the last-position per-token basis)
# selector (verbatim, suppressed_activation_subspace.py):
rise = logits[:, 1] - logits[:, 0]; fall = logits[:, 1] - logits[:, 2]
rise = rise - rise.mean(-1, keepdim=True); fall = fall - fall.mean(-1, keepdim=True)
return torch.minimum(rise.clamp_min(0), fall.clamp_min(0))

=== PRIMARY EVIDENCE 3: measured results (12 dev questions per batch) ===
Condition = replacement equation at C=1.5, last-3 prefill + every decode call.
swap = donor-vs-source next-token log-odds shift (nats), means over 12 cells:
  L20 (bank-selector bases): per_token +0.20, full_union +0.25 (support-corrected
    replay; the unguarded full_union +0.60 was invalid: 1-8 null columns), top8 +0.25
  L20 randoms (seeded Haar rank-8/32 projectors, real donor states): +0.06/-0.03/-0.06
  C0 exact identity everywhere.
  L25 (same bases, same equation): per_token +1.95, full_union +2.85, top8 +2.22;
    naming-dog split (4 cells): +5.40 / +6.30 / +6.23; largest cells +11.4 to +13.9
  L25 randoms: -0.01 / +0.27 / +0.12 (their captured donor components are smaller:
    total applied norms 184-417 vs constructions 533-787)
  Historical recovered reference (DIFFERENT equation h + C(delta - P_ref h), additive
    template-attenuation delta, L20): swap +10.01, primary semantic success 6/12 on

Observed L25 behavior (verbatim excerpt, full_union name-N1-dog, swap +11.36):

    insects is the **spider**.\n\nThe spider is a small, eight-legged arachnid ...'

  to spider. Ant cells and property cells unmoved at both layers. Coherence preserved
  (repetition r2 <= 0.12); 1-2 of 12 cells cap at 128 tokens.

are the last three; block l writes h_(l+1) - h_l.

  energy on source (-20.7) and control (-3.2); dog grows (+11.6).
Caveat: the selection favors readout rise-then-fall, so the fall of selected tokens is
  not independent validation of the criterion.
